text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on portfolio goals and risk—not simply on whether a position is profitable.","I should assess each holding as part of the whole portfolio, rather than letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake keep me invested.","With no trades for several periods and no predictive signal in these random price moves, I should avoid unnecessary reactions and trade only when my plan or circumstances warrant it."]}
